what: Cells straddling the first screen rise one after another from the top (.075s), from the bottom edge of the screen to their place over 1.3s expo. Each cell’s rise distance is (screen height − its top), so lower cells rise a shorter way and all enter from off-screen. The text inside the cells (name, number) rises with the same distance and curve. Off-screen cells do not move

options.delay: Start delay (seconds), default 0 — match it to when the loader clears
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Rising cell (photo panel). The [data-fx-part that wraps the cell=box] is present, distance is measured from it, and the [data-fx-part inside it=text] rises too

from.where: index.html .g-projects (first appearance of the work grid) · shared.js intro()
